title: Trail
line: Keep a decision with a pointer to its evidence.

beats.caption: You ask the agent to record a decision.
Trail checks the file and line in the entry.
beats.label: pi-trail

beats.caption: The decision goes into the session’s local trail.

takeaway.title: Record the reason and the evidence
takeaway.line: Leave enough detail to check the decision later.

title.text: Weeks later, a diff can tell you what changed and leave you wondering why.

scene.text: The agent records why the default greeting stays and points at the relevant line. Trail checks that the pointer resolves when it writes the entry.

takeaway.text: Give the trail the decision, a short reason, and a place to look. That makes the record useful when you return to the work.
